title: Canonical comparison with any local affine presentation
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $F,F\prime$ presheaves on its scheme tests, $T,T\prime$ schemes over $S$, $f:F\to h_T$, $f\prime:F\prime\to h_{T\prime}$, and $k:F\prime\to F$, $g:T\prime\to T$ satisfy $kf=f\prime h_g$. Let $L$ be a test-line family [def-trf-cartesian-line-presentation] on $F$, and let $M,M\prime$ be section-Proj models [def-trf-section-proj-model] for $(f,L)$ and $(f\prime,k^*L)$. Suppose $B$ is another normalized local section algebra and $\beta:g^*M.A\simeq B$ is a SpaceSectionAlgebraBaseChange [lem-trf-space-section-algebra-etale-base-change], and $B$ agrees with ordinary scheme direct images and counits. Then $M\prime.A$ also agrees with ordinary schemes. There are a normalized base-change comparison $\beta\prime:g^*M.A\simeq M\prime.A$ and affine graded PullbackData $D$ such that on an affine $V\prime\subseteq g^{-1}V$ the image of every degree-$n$ section $s$ is precisely the image under $M\prime.degreeIso$ of $\beta\prime_n(1\otimes s)|_{V\prime}$. The evaluations of $M,M\prime$ satisfy IsBaseChange with respect to $D$. No covering, generation or open-immersion condition is involved.

source.place: Tag 03LX, etale base change by restriction of compatible sections; constructions.tex Tag 01LH; spaces-descent.tex Tag 0D3C.

proof.text: The sections universal properties identify B and M-prime.A as the same compatible families on every base open and in every degree. These unique mutually inverse maps are linear, restriction-compatible and preserve the evaluation, multiplication and unit. Sum the maps and transport beta to beta-prime.

Conjugate the degree maps on tensor sections by the two degreeIso maps, then extend to direct sums. Products, units and restrictions commute by their model and base-change equations. Affine quasi-coherent section base change gives degreewise scalar extension, producing PullbackData with the stated normalization.

Evaluate either path on a homogeneous section: beta.evaluation and evaluation_eq give the same restricted section. This is IsBaseChange. Transport the ordinary-scheme comparison of B through the degree isomorphisms; its counit equation is preserved by the evaluation identity.

theorem section_proj_model_comparison
    {F F' : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {T T' : Over S}
    {f : F ⟶ yoneda.obj T} {f' : F' ⟶ yoneda.obj T'} {L : TestLineFamily F}
    (k : F' ⟶ F) (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (hcomm : k ≫ f = f' ≫ yoneda.map g)
    (M : SectionProjModel f L) (M' : SectionProjModel f' (L.pullback k))
    (B : SpaceSectionAlgebra f' (L.pullback k))
    (beta : SpaceSectionAlgebraBaseChange k g M.sections B) (hB : B.AgreesWithSchemes) :
    M'.sections.AgreesWithSchemes ∧
      ∃ (β : SpaceSectionAlgebraBaseChange k g M.sections M'.sections)
        (D : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData g.left M.affine M'.affine),
        (∀ (V : T.left.affineOpens) (V' : T'.left.affineOpens)
          (h : V'.1 ≤ g.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) (n : ℕ) (s : Γ(M.sections.degree n, V.1)),
          D.map h (M.degreeIso V n s) =
            (M'.degreeIso V' n ((β.degree n).hom.app V'.1
              (sectionAlgebraPullSection g.left (M.sections.degree n)
                V.1 V'.1 h s)) : M'.affine.obj V')) ∧
        M.evaluation.IsBaseChange k g D M'.evaluation
